question: When was the 'Vivad se Vishwas II (Contractual Disputes)' scheme announced by the Union Finance Minister?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Budget 2023-24**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **'Vivad se Vishwas II (Contractual Disputes)'** scheme was **announced** by the **Union Finance Minister** during the **Union Budget 2023-24**.
 
• This scheme aims to **settle contractual disputes** involving the government and government undertakings.
 
• The scheme is intended to **reduce litigation** and create a **favorable business environment**.
 
• It is part of the government's broader efforts to **improve the ease of doing business** in India.
 
• The scheme provides a **mechanism for voluntary settlement** of disputes with the government.
 
• It is an extension of the original **'Vivad se Vishwas' scheme**, which was focused on **tax disputes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Union Budget 2020-21**

 
 
• The **Union Budget 2020-21** included the announcement of the original **'Vivad se Vishwas' scheme**, aimed at resolving **tax disputes**.
 
• It also focused on **infrastructure development** and **agriculture**.
 
 
 
• **Union Budget 2021-22**
 
 
• This budget emphasized **healthcare and infrastructure**, with significant allocations to **COVID-19 vaccination** and **public health**.
 
• It introduced the **Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme** for various sectors.
 
 
 
• **Union Budget 2022-23**
 
 
• The **Union Budget 2022-23** focused on **digital economy**, **fintech**, and **technology-enabled development**.
 
• It announced the launch of **Digital Rupee** and **e-passports**.
